# A104 scientific_process

This existing `scientific_process` episode is commissioned by `legacy_annotation`. The binding inventory retains its original files, symbols, dependencies and current private source hashes. Its full responsibility split is incomplete: central task execution still uses the axis runtime, and the existing requests/returns and binding implementation require further review.

## 2026-11-11 monitor message ownership

`to_child_execution_progress_assessment.py -> execution_progress_assessment/from_parent.py` prepares the selected target, requested fields, known observations and permitted records. `execution_progress_assessment/to_parent.py -> from_child_execution_progress_assessment.py` validates requested progress references and records them with the original provider signature and delivery key. Runtime chooses the original child from saved actions/report attempts, including repair; mismatched parents are rejected. The parent does not poll or manufacture progress in these message functions.

All 21 existing parent methods retain their bodies. The two explicit connectors are additions. Current fingerprints include both new message files; configuration and historical descriptor provenance remain distinct. Four local boundary checks pass, using the shared database-only test helper under root/tests. The full run had 504 passes and 28 failures; 26 failures came from the test expecting ContractError instead of the original ReportBoundaryError. Correcting that assertion and rerunning those 26 checks gives 530 current passes; two A106 scientific Store construction checks retain their reproduced pre-existing failure. Evidence: `runs/monitor_parent_tree_20261111_{baseline02,connect,behavior,recheck,records}/`. These checks do not establish scientific execution, autonomous HPC behavior or whole-workflow restoration.

## 2026-11-11 canonical workflow resource infrastructure

The scientific descriptor now records the exact actual non-test own-axis source digest. The 31-import/five-retirement stage is proven against a complete pre-stage map; older fingerprint deltas are retained separately and do not acquire new behavior claims.

The same actual launcher/owner now serves these consumers. The canonical checker, launcher, one-CPU/5-GiB/no-swap bounds and authentication guards are unchanged. Four axes previously failed sixteen owner checks; after the import repair their eight default Policy/Resources boundaries and three ToolRegistries return, and all five redundant copies are retired. A104's ToolRegistry now exposes a separate missing `local_tools` KeyError. A102 retains its three separately observed missing-default KeyErrors. These are constructor diagnostics, not a test-pass count or native/scientific workflow validation.

Original checker sources, metadata, fingerprints and receipts remain historical. Any source changes predating this repair are listed separately from its exact delta. The existing CPU/thread gate is documented by a separate no-native diagnostic and remains open; no count limit or stopping rule was added. Full private splitting and saved-workflow restoration remain incomplete. Complete scoped evidence: `runs/workflow_resource_infrastructure_20261111_records_prepare`.
